title: Unit – 4 : Session – 9 : SLO – 2  |  Odd Man Out — Pipelining Basics
sections: 1. Group Fetch, Decode, Execute, Write-back, Compiler → Compiler — software; the rest are pipeline stages.
2. Group Data hazard, Control hazard, Structural hazard, Cache miss → Cache miss — a memory-hierarchy event, not a pipeline hazard class.
3. Group Bypassing, Branch prediction, Operand forwarding, Interrupt handling → Interrupt handling — OS/exception mechanism; the others are hazard-mitigation techniques.
4. Group RISC pipeline, Superscalar, VLIW, Hard disk → Hard disk — storage device; the others are instruction-level-parallel architectures.
5. Group Pipeline register, ALU, Program Counter, Power supply → Power supply — not a processor datapath/control element.
6. Group Throughput, Latency, Speedup, Voltage → Voltage — an electrical property, not a performance metric.
7. Group 5-stage, 7-stage, 10-stage pipeline, Binary code → Binary code — a representation, not a pipeline configuration.
8. Group Bubble, Stall, Flush, Accelerate → Accelerate — the others are pipeline disruption terms.
9. Group Instruction-level parallelism, Data parallelism, Sequential execution → Sequential execution — the absence of parallelism.
10. Group CPI, IPC, MIPS, USB → USB — an I/O interface standard; the others are CPU performance metrics.
